xc_files.name: main.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; =====================================================================
;  EarthNAV - a world map for ChipOS (App Kit v4 add-on).
;  Put this drive in its own computer on the same data network as ChipOS,
;  give that computer an alias (e.g. "app-earthnav") and alias the ChipOS
;  computer "chipos". EarthNAV gets the nav position, heading and target and
;  the saved contacts from ChipOS, draws the map picture and sends it to
;  ChipOS, which shows it in the app, as a home widget and on other screens.
;  Map data: GSHHG 2.3 high resolution shorelines, lakes, rivers and borders
;  (LGPL, Wessel & Smith) and Natural Earth cities (public domain).
; =====================================================================
include "chipos-appkit.xc"
include "world.xc"

storage var $en_ver : number
storage var $en_zi : number              ; zoom step 0..13
storage var $en_rot : number             ; 1 = heading up (map turns), 0 = north up
storage var $en_follow : number          ; 1 = centre on the nav
storage var $en_plat : number            ; centre when not following
storage var $en_plon : number
storage var $en_lay : number             ; 1 rivers 2 borders 4 cities 8 contacts 16 trail
storage var $en_flip : number            ; 1 / -1: the way ChipOS turns the picture

const $LW = 860                          ; layer size (as in ChipOS)
const $KY = 110.574                      ; km per degree of latitude

; ---------- zoom ----------
; km across a 300 pixel view
function @en_zoom_km($i : number) : number
	var $z = 12800
	repeat $i ($q)
		$z = $z / 2
	return $z

function @en_kpp($i : number) : number
	return @en_zoom_km($i) / 300

function @en_lod($i : number) : number
	if $i <= 1
		return 4
	if $i <= 3
		return 3
	if $i == 4
		return 2
	if $i <= 6
		return 1
	return 0

function @en_maxrank($i : number) : number
	if $i <= 0
		return 1
	if $i <= 7
		return $i + 1
	return 10

function @wrap180($a : number) : number
	var $b = $a
	repeat 3 ($q)
		if $b > 180
			$b -= 360
		if $b < -180
			$b += 360
	return $b

; ---------- the layer being drawn (R) and the one ChipOS shows (F) ----------
var $r_lat0 = 0
var $r_lon0 = 0
var $r_kpp = 1
var $r_kx = 111
var $r_zi = 0
var $r_lid = -1
var $f_lat0 = 0
var $f_lon0 = 0
var $f_kpp = 1
var $f_kx = 111
var $f_zi = -1
var $f_lid = -2
var $f_ok = 0
array $rc_x : number                     ; cities in the layer being drawn
array $rc_y : number
array $rc_n : text
array $fc_x : number                     ; ... and in the one shown
array $fc_y : number
array $fc_n : text

; layer pixel of a place, in the shown layer -> $px, $py
var $px = 0
var $py = 0
function @f_place($lat : number, $lon : number)
	$px = $LW / 2 + @wrap180($lon - $f_lon0) * $f_kx / $f_kpp
	$py = $LW / 2 - ($lat - $f_lat0) * $KY / $f_kpp

; a place at bearing b (deg) and distance d (m) -> $plat, $plon
var $plat = 0
var $plon = 0
function @geo_move($lat : number, $lon : number, $b : number, $d : number)
	var $br = $b * pi / 180
	$plat = $lat + $d * cos($br) / 111320
	$plon = @wrap180($lon + $d * sin($br) / (111320 * max(cos($lat * pi / 180), 0.01)))

; ---------- decoding ----------
var $ds = ""                             ; text being read
var $dp = 0                              ; position
function @dn() : number
	var $v = 0
	var $sh = 1
	repeat 8 ($q)
		var $c = find($wn_alpha, substring($ds, $dp, 1))
		$dp += 1
		if $c >= 32
			$v += ($c - 32) * $sh
			$sh = $sh * 32
		else
			$v += max($c, 0) * $sh
			if mod($v, 2) == 1
				return -($v + 1) / 2
			return $v / 2
	return 0

; ---------- work budget: a share of this computer's instructions per tick ----------
var $i_start = 0
var $i_bud = 40000
function @room() : number
	return (ipc - $i_start) < $i_bud

; ---------- the drawing job ----------
var $jb = 0                              ; 0 idle, 2 tiles, 3 sort, 4 fill, 5 lines, 6 cities
var $j_lod = 0
var $j_u = 600                           ; units per degree at this detail
var $j_rs = 1                            ; fill row height
var $j_rows = 860
array $jt : number                       ; tiles to read (index)
array $jt_ox : number                    ; their pixel origin (south west corner)
array $jt_oy : number
array $jt_left : number                  ; 1: left-most column (starts the fill)
var $j_ti = 0                            ; tile
var $j_ci = 0                            ; text piece within the tile
var $j_cn = 0
var $j_tsx = 1
var $j_tsy = 1
array $xk : number                       ; fill crossings: row * 2048 + x + 2 (land)
array $xk2 : number                      ; ... the bottom half of the rows (arrays hold 65535)
array $xl : number                       ; ... lakes drawn over the land
var $xsel = 0                            ; edges go to: 0 land, 1 lakes
var $jf = 0                              ; filling: 0 land, 1 lakes
array $lo_r : text                       ; finished line drawings: rivers
array $lo_c : text                       ; shores
array $lo_b : text                       ; borders
var $j_k = 0
var $j_ci2 = 0
var $j_ty0 = 0
var $j_lw0 = 0
var $j_nc = 0
var $j_nrw = 0
var $j_c = 0

; current polyline being built
var $pl_n = 0
var $pl_t = ""
var $pl_x0 = 0
var $pl_y0 = 0
var $pl_lx = 0
var $pl_ly = 0
var $pl_col = 0

function @pl_flush($kind : number)
	if $pl_n >= 2
		var $op = @kit_venc(0) & @kit_venc($pl_col) & @kit_venc($pl_n) & @kit_venc($pl_x0) & @kit_venc($pl_y0) & $pl_t
		if ($kind == 1) or ($kind == 5)
			$lo_c.append($op)
		elseif $kind == 2
			$lo_r.append($op)
		else
			$lo_b.append($op)
	$pl_n = 0
	$pl_t = ""

function @pl_point($kind : number, $x : number, $y : number)
	var $xi = round($x)
	var $yi = round($y)
	if $pl_n == 0
		$pl_x0 = $xi
		$pl_y0 = $yi
		$pl_n = 1
	else
		$pl_t = $pl_t & @kit_venc($xi - $pl_lx) & @kit_venc($yi - $pl_ly)
		$pl_n += 1
		if $pl_n >= 120
			@pl_flush($kind)
			$pl_x0 = $xi
			$pl_y0 = $yi
			$pl_n = 1
	$pl_lx = $xi
	$pl_ly = $yi

; crossings of one shore edge with the fill rows
function @edge_x($xa : number, $ya : number, $xb : number, $yb : number)
	if $ya == $yb
		return
	var $lo = min($ya, $yb)
	var $hi = max($ya, $yb)
	if ($hi < 0) or ($lo > $LW) or (min($xa, $xb) > $LW + 1)
		return
	var $r0 = max(0, ceil(($lo - $j_rs / 2) / $j_rs))
	var $r1 = min($j_rows - 1, ceil(($hi - $j_rs / 2) / $j_rs) - 1)
	var $nr = $r1 - $r0 + 1
	if $nr <= 0
		return
	var $sl = ($xb - $xa) / ($yb - $ya)
	if $xsel == 0
		var $half = floor($j_rows / 2)
		repeat $nr ($q)
			var $r = $r0 + $q
			var $key = $r * 2048 + clamp(round($xa + ($r * $j_rs + $j_rs / 2 - $ya) * $sl), -1, $LW + 1) + 2
			if $r < $half
				if $xk.size < 65000
					$xk.append($key)
			elseif $xk2.size < 65000
				$xk2.append($key)
	else
		if $xl.size > 65000
			return
		repeat $nr ($q2)
			var $r2 = $r0 + $q2
			$xl.append($r2 * 2048 + clamp(round($xa + ($r2 * $j_rs + $j_rs / 2 - $ya) * $sl), -1, $LW + 1) + 2)

function @job_start($lat : number, $lon : number, $zi : number)
	$r_lat0 = clamp($lat, -85, 85)
	$r_lon0 = @wrap180($lon)
	$r_zi = $zi
	$r_kpp = @en_kpp($zi)
	$r_kx = 111.32 * max(cos($r_lat0 * pi / 180), 0.05)
	$j_lod = @en_lod($zi)
	$j_u = $wl_u.$j_lod
	$j_rs = 1
	if $r_kpp > 3
		$j_rs = 2
	$j_rows = ceil($LW / $j_rs)
	$xk.clear()
	$xk2.clear()
	$xl.clear()
	$lo_r.clear()
	$lo_c.clear()
	$lo_b.clear()
	$rc_x.clear()
	$rc_y.clear()
	$rc_n.clear()
	$jt.clear()
	$jt_ox.clear()
	$jt_oy.clear()
	$jt_left.clear()
	; tiles under the layer (listed in phase 1)
	var $hh = $LW / 2 * $r_kpp / $KY
	var $hw = $LW / 2 * $r_kpp / $r_kx
	$j_ty0 = clamp(floor(($r_lat0 - $hh + 90) / 5), 0, 35)
	var $ty1 = clamp(floor(($r_lat0 + $hh + 90) / 5), 0, 35)
	$j_lw0 = floor(($r_lon0 - min($hw, 180) + 180) / 5)
	$j_nc = min(72, floor(($r_lon0 + min($hw, 180) + 180) / 5) - $j_lw0 + 1)
	$j_nrw = $ty1 - $j_ty0 + 1
	$j_c = 0
	$j_ti = 0
	$j_ci = 0
	$j_cn = -1
	$jb = 1
	$r_lid = @kit_layer_begin("#16304a", "#24382c,#6aa6d8,#3a86d8,#b8b8c4,#7c7c8a,#16304a")

; one feature; returns roughly how many points it took
function @feature($ti : number) : number
	var $kind = @dn()
	var $len = @dn()
	var $end = $dp + $len
	var $ox = $jt_ox.$ti
	var $oy = $jt_oy.$ti
	var $sx = $r_kx / ($r_kpp * $j_u)
	var $sy = $KY / ($r_kpp * $j_u)
	if $kind >= 9
		var $ya = @dn()
		var $yb = @dn()
		$dp = $end
		$xsel = $kind == 10
		if $jt_left.$ti
			; the left edge of the first tile column: inside land between ya and yb
			@edge_x($ox - 2, $oy - $ya * $sy, $ox - 2, $oy - $yb * $sy)
		return 1
	var $bx0 = $ox + @dn() * $sx
	var $by1 = $oy - @dn() * $sy
	var $bx1 = $ox + @dn() * $sx
	var $by0 = $oy - @dn() * $sy
	var $skip = ($by0 > $LW) or ($by1 < 0) or ($bx0 > $LW + 1)
	if $kind == 2
		$skip = $skip or !mod($en_lay, 2) or ($bx1 < 0)
	elseif ($kind == 3) or ($kind == 4)
		$skip = $skip or !mod(floor($en_lay / 2), 2) or ($bx1 < 0)
	if $skip
		$dp = $end
		return 1
	var $n = @dn()
	var $rx = @dn()
	var $ry = @dn()
	var $xa = $ox + $rx * $sx
	var $ya = $oy - $ry * $sy
	var $ring = ($kind == 1) or ($kind == 5)
	$xsel = $kind == 5
	var $draw = !$ring or ($bx1 >= 0)
	$pl_col = 1
	if $kind == 2
		$pl_col = 2
	elseif $kind == 3
		$pl_col = 3
	elseif $kind == 4
		$pl_col = 4
	$pl_n = 0
	$pl_t = ""
	if $draw
		@pl_point($kind, $xa, $ya)
	var $tx = mod($jt.$ti, 72)
	var $ty = floor($jt.$ti / 72)
	var $top = 5 * $j_u
	var $m = $n - 1
	var $lx = $xa
	var $ly = $ya
	repeat $m ($k)
		var $rx2 = $rx + @dn()
		var $ry2 = $ry + @dn()
		var $xb = $ox + $rx2 * $sx
		var $yb = $oy - $ry2 * $sy
		var $last = $k == $m - 1
		; drop points closer than a pixel (but keep the last)
		if $last or (abs($xb - $lx) + abs($yb - $ly) >= 1.5)
			if $ring
				@edge_x($lx, $ly, $xb, $yb)
			if $draw
				; the world's edge (date line, south pole) is not a shore
				var $edge = (($rx2 == $rx) and ((($rx == 0) and ($tx == 0)) or (($rx == $top) and ($tx == 71)))) or (($ry2 == $ry) and ($ry == 0) and ($ty == 0))
				var $out = (($lx < 0) and ($xb < 0)) or (($lx > $LW) and ($xb > $LW)) or (($ly < 0) and ($yb < 0)) or (($ly > $LW) and ($yb > $LW))
				if $edge or $out
					@pl_flush($kind)
				else
					if $pl_n == 0
						@pl_point($kind, $lx, $ly)
					@pl_point($kind, $xb, $yb)
			$lx = $xb
			$ly = $yb
		$rx = $rx2
		$ry = $ry2
	if $draw
		@pl_flush($kind)
	$dp = $end
	return $n

function @job_list()
	repeat 72 ($q)
		if ($j_c >= $j_nc) or !@room()
			break
		var $col = $j_lw0 + $j_c
		var $tx = mod($col + 720, 72)
		var $ox = $LW / 2 + ($col * 5 - 180 - $r_lon0) * $r_kx / $r_kpp
		repeat $j_nrw ($r)
			var $ty = $j_ty0 + $r
			$jt.append($ty * 72 + $tx)
			$jt_ox.append($ox)
			$jt_oy.append($LW / 2 - ($ty * 5 - 90 - $r_lat0) * $KY / $r_kpp)
			$jt_left.append($j_c == 0)
		$j_c += 1
	if $j_c >= $j_nc
		$jb = 2

; read features until about $bud points are done
function @job_tiles($bud : number)
	var $used = 0
	var $ntile = $jt.size
	repeat 3000 ($guard)
		if ($jb != 2) or !@room()
			break
		if 1
			if $j_ti >= $ntile
				$jb = 3
			else
				var $t = $jt.$j_ti
				var $base = $j_lod * 2592 + $t
				if $j_cn < 0
					$j_cn = $wt_n.$base
					$j_ci = 0
					$dp = 0
					$ds = ""
					if $j_cn > 0
						$ds = $wd.($wt_s.$base)
				if $j_ci >= $j_cn
					$j_ti += 1
					$j_cn = -1
				elseif $dp >= size($ds)
					$j_ci += 1
					$dp = 0
					if $j_ci < $j_cn
						$ds = $wd.($wt_s.$base + $j_ci)
				else
					$used += @feature($j_ti) + 3

; fill: sorted crossings -> filled spans per row
function @xkey($i : number) : number
	if $jf == 0
		return $xk.$i
	if $jf == 1
		return $xk2.$i
	return $xl.$i

function @fill_n() : number
	if $jf == 0
		return $xk.size
	if $jf == 1
		return $xk2.size
	return $xl.size

; fill: sorted crossings -> filled spans, one layer op per row
var $f_row = -1
var $f_sp = ""
var $f_cnt = 0
var $f_last = 0
function @fill_flush()
	if $f_cnt > 0
		var $fc = 0
		if $jf == 2
			$fc = 5
		@kit_layer_op(@kit_venc(1) & @kit_venc($fc) & @kit_venc($f_row * $j_rs) & @kit_venc($j_rs) & @kit_venc($f_cnt) & $f_sp)
	$f_sp = ""
	$f_cnt = 0
	$f_last = 0

function @job_fill($bud : number)
	var $n = @fill_n()
	repeat $bud ($it)
		if ($jb != 4) or !@room()
			break
		if 1
			if $j_k >= $n
				@fill_flush()
				$f_row = -1
				$j_k = 0
				if $jf < 2
					$jf += 1
					$n = @fill_n()
				else
					$jb = 5
			else
				var $k0 = @xkey($j_k)
				var $row = floor($k0 / 2048)
				if $row != $f_row
					@fill_flush()
					$f_row = $row
				var $a = clamp($k0 - $row * 2048 - 2, 0, $LW)
				var $b = $LW
				var $pair = 0
				if $j_k + 1 < $n
					var $k1 = @xkey($j_k + 1)
					if floor($k1 / 2048) == $row
						$b = clamp($k1 - $row * 2048 - 2, 0, $LW)
						$pair = 1
				if $b > $a
					$f_sp = $f_sp & @kit_venc($a - $f_last) & @kit_venc($b - $a)
					$f_cnt += 1
					$f_last = $b
				$j_k += 1 + $pair

function @job_lines($bud : number)
	var $used = 0
	var $nr = $lo_r.size
	var $nc = $lo_c.size
	var $nb = $lo_b.size
	repeat 3000 ($guard)
		if ($jb != 5) or !@room()
			break
		if 1
			if $j_k < $nr
				@kit_layer_op($lo_r.$j_k)
			elseif $j_k < $nr + $nc
				@kit_layer_op($lo_c.($j_k - $nr))
			elseif $j_k < $nr + $nc + $nb
				@kit_layer_op($lo_b.($j_k - $nr - $nc))
			else
				$jb = 6
				$j_k = 0
			$j_k += 1
			$used += 1

function @job_cities($bud : number)
	var $n = $wc_name.size
	var $mr = @en_maxrank($r_zi)
	repeat $bud ($q)
		if ($jb != 6) or ($j_k >= $n) or !@room()
			break
		if 1
			if ($wc_r.$j_k <= $mr) and ($rc_n.size < 40)
				var $la = $wc_lat.$j_k / 100
				var $lo = $wc_lon.$j_k / 100
				var $x = $LW / 2 + @wrap180($lo - $r_lon0) * $r_kx / $r_kpp
				var $y = $LW / 2 - ($la - $r_lat0) * $KY / $r_kpp
				if ($x >= 0) and ($x <= $LW) and ($y >= 0) and ($y <= $LW)
					$rc_x.append($x)
					$rc_y.append($y)
					$rc_n.append($wc_name.$j_k)
			$j_k += 1
	if ($jb == 6) and ($j_k >= $n)
		@kit_layer_end()
		$jb = 0

function @job_step()
	if $jb == 1
		@job_list()
	elseif $jb == 2
		@job_tiles(700)
	elseif $jb == 3
		$xk.sort()
		$xk2.sort()
		$xl.sort()
		$jb = 4
		$jf = 0
		$j_k = 0
		$f_row = -1
		$f_sp = ""
		$f_cnt = 0
		$f_last = 0
	elseif $jb == 4
		@job_fill(5000)
	elseif $jb == 5
		@job_lines(200)
	elseif $jb == 6
		@job_cities(8000)

; the layer ChipOS shows changed: take over the drawing's numbers
function @job_done_check()
	if ($kit_lid_front == $r_lid) and ($f_lid != $r_lid) and ($jb == 0)
		$f_lid = $r_lid
		$f_lat0 = $r_lat0
		$f_lon0 = $r_lon0
		$f_kpp = $r_kpp
		$f_kx = $r_kx
		$f_zi = $r_zi
		$f_ok = 1
		$fc_x.clear()
		$fc_y.clear()
		$fc_n.clear()
		var $n = $rc_n.size
		repeat $n ($i)
			$fc_x.append($rc_x.$i)
			$fc_y.append($rc_y.$i)
			$fc_n.append($rc_n.$i)
		$kit_dirty = 1
		$kit_wdirty = 1

; ---------- the view ----------
var $v_lat = 0
var $v_lon = 0
function @view_centre()
	if $en_follow and $kit_nav_ok
		$v_lat = $kit_lat
		$v_lon = $kit_lon
	else
		$v_lat = $en_plat
		$v_lon = $en_plon

; a new picture when zoomed, or when the view nears the edge of the one shown
var $lay_drawn = -1
function @need_check()
	if $jb != 0
		return
	if @kit_layer_busy()
		return
	@view_centre()
	var $need = !$f_ok or ($f_zi != $en_zi) or ($lay_drawn != $en_lay)
	if !$need
		@f_place($v_lat, $v_lon)
		$need = (abs($px - $LW / 2) > 70) or (abs($py - $LW / 2) > 70)
	if $need
		$lay_drawn = $en_lay
		@job_start($v_lat, $v_lon, $en_zi)

; trail (every 10 s when it moved)
array $tr_lat : number
array $tr_lon : number
var $tr_next = 0
function @trail_tick()
	if !$kit_nav_ok or (time < $tr_next)
		return
	$tr_next = time + 10
	var $n = $tr_lat.size
	if $n > 0
		if (abs($tr_lat.($n - 1) - $kit_lat) + abs($tr_lon.($n - 1) - $kit_lon)) < 0.0003
			return
	$tr_lat.append($kit_lat)
	$tr_lon.append($kit_lon)
	if $tr_lat.size > 300
		$tr_lat.erase(0)
		$tr_lon.erase(0)

function @dist_s($m : number) : text
	if $kit_units
		if $m < 1609.34
			return text("{0} ft", $m * 3.28084)
		return text("{0.0} mi", $m / 1609.34)
	if $m < 1000
		return text("{0} m", $m)
	return text("{0.0} km", $m / 1000)

; The map picture inside x, y, w, h (% of the area). Buttons go right after
; it (so they always fit in the screen text), then @draw_over.
function @draw_view($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number)
	@view_centre()
	var $turn = 0
	if $en_rot and $kit_nav_ok
		$turn = -$kit_hdg
	if !$f_ok
		@kit_view($x, $y, $w, $h, $LW / 2, $LW / 2, 0, $en_flip)
		return
	@f_place($v_lat, $v_lon)
	@kit_view($x, $y, $w, $h, $px, $py, $turn, $en_flip)

; Everything drawn on the map.
function @draw_over()
	if !$f_ok
		@kit_vmsg("dim", "DRAWING MAP...")
		return
	; me first, so labels keep off the arrow
	if $kit_nav_ok
		@f_place($kit_lat, $kit_lon)
		@kit_varrow($px, $py, $kit_hdg, "#42a0ff")
	; cities
	if mod(floor($en_lay / 4), 2)
		var $nc = min($fc_n.size, 25)
		repeat $nc ($i)
			@kit_vcity($fc_x.$i, $fc_y.$i, $fc_n.$i)
	; trail
	if mod(floor($en_lay / 16), 2) and ($tr_lat.size > 1)
		var $pts = ""
		var $n = $tr_lat.size
		var $from = max(0, $n - 80)
		var $lx = -9999
		var $ly = -9999
		var $cnt = $n - $from
		repeat $cnt ($i)
			@f_place($tr_lat.($from + $i), $tr_lon.($from + $i))
			if (abs($px - $lx) + abs($py - $ly) >= 3) or ($i == $cnt - 1)
				if $pts != ""
					$pts = $pts & ","
				$pts = $pts & text("{0},{0}", $px, $py)
				$lx = $px
				$ly = $py
		if $kit_nav_ok
			@f_place($kit_lat, $kit_lon)
			$pts = $pts & text(",{0},{0}", $px, $py)
		@kit_vpoly("#f0c040", $pts)
	; contacts: pinned when they send their position, else from the beacon
	if mod(floor($en_lay / 8), 2)
		repeat $kit_cn ($i)
			var $have = 0
			if $kit_c_fix.$i
				$plat = $kit_c_lat.$i
				$plon = $kit_c_lon.$i
				$have = 2
			elseif $kit_nav_ok and ($kit_c_brg.$i >= 0) and ($kit_c_dist.$i > 0)
				@geo_move($kit_lat, $kit_lon, $kit_c_brg.$i, $kit_c_dist.$i)
				$have = 1
			if $have
				@f_place($plat, $plon)
				if $have == 2
					@kit_vdot($px, $py, 4, "#7ee08a")
				else
					@kit_vring($px, $py, 4, "#7ee08a")
				@kit_vlabel($px, $py, "#7ee08a", $kit_c_name.$i)
	; the nav's target
	if $kit_nav_ok and ($kit_tdist > 0)
		@geo_move($kit_lat, $kit_lon, $kit_tbrg, $kit_tdist)
		@f_place($plat, $plon)
		var $tx = $px
		var $ty = $py
		@f_place($kit_lat, $kit_lon)
		@kit_vline($px, $py, $tx, $ty, "#ff4fd8")
		@kit_vdot($tx, $ty, 4, "#ff4fd8")
		@kit_vnote("#ff4fd8", "TARGET " & @dist_s($kit_tdist))
	; me again, on top of the lines
	if $kit_nav_ok
		@f_place($kit_lat, $kit_lon)
		@kit_varrow($px, $py, $kit_hdg, "#42a0ff")
	if $en_rot and $kit_nav_ok
		@kit_vcompass()
	else
		@kit_vnorth()
	@kit_vscale($f_kpp)
	if !$kit_nav_ok
		@kit_vmsg("warn", "NO NAV POSITION")
	elseif ($jb != 0) or @kit_layer_busy()
		if $f_zi != $en_zi
			@kit_vmsg("dim", "DRAWING...")

function @frame()
	@kit_begin()
	@draw_view(0, 0, 100, 84)
	@kit_button("zin", 1, 28, 10, 13, "+")
	@kit_button("zout", 1, 43, 10, 13, "-")
	var $rl = "N"
	if $en_rot
		$rl = "H"
	@kit_button("rot", 89, 28, 10, 13, $rl)
	var $ml = "ME"
	if !$en_follow
		$ml = "ME?"
	@kit_button("me", 89, 43, 10, 13, $ml)
	if !$en_follow
		@kit_button("pn", 44, 1, 12, 9, "^")
		@kit_button("ps", 44, 73, 12, 9, "v")
		@kit_button("pw", 1, 60, 10, 11, "<")
		@kit_button("pe", 89, 60, 10, 11, ">")
	@kit_text(1, 1, 1, "dim", text("ZOOM {}/14", $en_zi + 1))
	repeat 5 ($b)
		var $bit = 1
		repeat $b ($q)
			$bit = $bit * 2
		var $on = mod(floor($en_lay / $bit), 2)
		var $nm = ""
		if $b == 0
			$nm = "RIVERS"
		elseif $b == 1
			$nm = "BORDERS"
		elseif $b == 2
			$nm = "CITIES"
		elseif $b == 3
			$nm = "PEOPLE"
		else
			$nm = "TRAIL"
		if !$on
			$nm = $nm & " OFF"
		@kit_button(text("lay{}", $bit), $b * 16.6 + 0.3, 86, 16, 13, $nm)
	@kit_button("flip", 83.3, 86, 16.4, 13, "TURN FIX")
	@draw_over()
	@kit_end()

function @widget()
	@kit_begin()
	@draw_view(0, 0, 100, 100)
	@kit_button("zin", 1, 2, 14, 16, "+")
	@kit_button("zout", 1, 20, 14, 16, "-")
	@draw_over()
	@kit_wend(0)

function @tap($t : text)
	if $t == "zin"
		$en_zi = min($en_zi + 1, 13)
	elseif $t == "zout"
		$en_zi = max($en_zi - 1, 0)
	elseif $t == "rot"
		$en_rot = !$en_rot
	elseif $t == "me"
		if $en_follow
			@view_centre()
			$en_plat = $v_lat
			$en_plon = $v_lon
			$en_follow = 0
		else
			$en_follow = 1
	elseif $t == "flip"
		$en_flip = -$en_flip
	elseif find($t, "lay") == 0
		var $b = 0
		$b = substring($t, 3, size($t))
		if mod(floor($en_lay / $b), 2)
			$en_lay -= $b
		else
			$en_lay += $b
	elseif find($t, "p") == 0
		; pan a quarter of a 300 pixel view
		var $st = @en_kpp($en_zi) * 75
		if !$en_follow
			if $t == "pn"
				$en_plat = clamp($en_plat + $st / $KY, -85, 85)
			elseif $t == "ps"
				$en_plat = clamp($en_plat - $st / $KY, -85, 85)
			elseif $t == "pe"
				$en_plon = @wrap180($en_plon + $st / (111.32 * max(cos($en_plat * pi / 180), 0.05)))
			elseif $t == "pw"
				$en_plon = @wrap180($en_plon - $st / (111.32 * max(cos($en_plat * pi / 180), 0.05)))
	$kit_dirty = 1
	$kit_wdirty = 1

init
	if $en_ver != 1
		$en_ver = 1
		$en_zi = 8
		$en_rot = 0
		$en_follow = 1
		$en_plat = 35.78
		$en_plon = -78.64
		$en_lay = 31
		$en_flip = 1
	@wn_load()
	@kit_widget("EARTHNAV", 2, 2)
	@kit_icon("C,0,0,36,#173f6e;T,0,-30,-22,26,0,12,#5ab4ff;T,0,-30,22,26,0,12,#2f86e0")
	@kit_want("nav,contacts")
	@kit_canvas()
	@kit_app("EarthNAV", "#2a6fc0", "E")

update
	$i_start = ipc
	$i_bud = 40000
	if system_ipc > 0
		$i_bud = clamp(system_ipc * 0.3, 5000, 60000)
	@kit_poll()
	if $kit_clear
		$en_ver = 0
		$tr_lat.clear()
		$tr_lon.clear()
	if $kit_tap != ""
		var $tp = $kit_tap
		if find($tp, "open:") == 0
			$tp = substring($tp, 5, size($tp))
		@tap($tp)
	if $kit_feed_new
		@trail_tick()
		$kit_dirty = 1
	@job_done_check()
	@need_check()
	@job_step()
	if @kit_should_draw()
		@frame()
	if @kit_widget_due()
		@widget()

xc_files.name: chipos-appkit.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; =====================================================================
; ChipOS App Kit v4  -  include this in an app computer's program.
;  Give THIS computer any alias, and alias the ChipOS computer "chipos"
;  (both on the same router network). ChipOS finds the app by itself.
;
;  In your program:
;    include "chipos-appkit.xc"
;    init:    @kit_app("NAME", "#rrggbb", "G")    ; name, icon colour, glyph
;    update:  @kit_poll()                         ; read events first
;             if $kit_tap == "my-button" ...      ; a button was tapped
;             if @kit_should_draw()               ; only while open & changed
;                 @kit_begin()
;                 @kit_text_c(50, 20, 2, "accent", "HELLO")
;                 @kit_button("my-button", 30, 60, 40, 15, "TAP ME")
;                 @kit_end()
;  Positions and sizes are % of the app area (0-100). Text size multiplies
;  ChipOS's own text size. Colours: text, dim, accent, ok, warn, bad, or
;  #rrggbb. Do not use the characters | and ~ in your text.
;  Values from ChipOS: $kit_open, $kit_clock ("14:05"), $kit_day,
;  $kit_units (0 metric / 1 imperial), $kit_mins (minutes since day 1
;  00:00, received at $kit_mins_t on this computer's clock).
;  Text input:  @kit_input("id", "Prompt", "starting text") pops up ChipOS's
;  keyboard; when the user presses DONE, $kit_input_id / $kit_input_text are
;  set for one tick (CANCEL sets $kit_input_id and $kit_input_cancel = 1).
;  Sound: @kit_beep(880, 0.3) plays on ChipOS's buzzers (frequency Hz, s).
;  Paragraph: @kit_para(x, y, w, size, colour, text) wraps text to width w.
;  Grid: @kit_grid(x, y, w, h, cols, rows, "0012...") draws coloured cells
;  (0 empty, 1 cyan 2 yellow 3 purple 4 green 5 red 6 blue 7 orange 8 grey 9 white).
;  Animations: call @kit_invalidate() to redraw (e.g. a running stopwatch).
;  Home-screen widgets (up to 4): in init, BEFORE @kit_app:
;    @kit_widget("NAME", 2, 1)            ; name, width, height in cells
;  then in update:
;    if @kit_widget_due()                 ; about once a second / after a tap
;        @kit_begin()  ...draw with the same calls...  @kit_wend(0)
;  (@kit_wend(n) for widget n). Widgets are drawn even when the app is
;  closed. A widget button whose id starts with "open:" opens the app and
;  passes the rest of the id as $kit_tap (e.g. "open:note_3").
;  ChipOS shows the app only while this program runs (heartbeat).
;  Icon (optional, before @kit_app): @kit_icon("R,-20,-20,20,20,#ffcc00;C,0,0,10")
;  draws your own icon on the tile instead of the glyph. Units: the tile is
;  -50..50 each way, y down. Shapes, separated by ; (colour optional, white):
;    R,x1,y1,x2,y2,#rrggbb  filled box     B,x1,y1,x2,y2,#rrggbb  box outline
;    L,x1,y1,x2,y2,#rrggbb  thick line     C,x,y,r,#rrggbb        filled circle
;    O,x,y,r,#rrggbb        ring           T,x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3,#rrggbb  triangle
;  Whole numbers only; up to 24 shapes. Without an icon ChipOS shows the glyph.
;  Clear data: when the user picks CLEAR DATA, $kit_clear is 1 for one tick;
;  reset your storage variables then.
;  ---- v4: data from ChipOS ----
;  @kit_want("nav,contacts") (before @kit_app) asks ChipOS for data, sent twice
;  a second; $kit_feed_new is 1 for one tick when some arrived.
;    nav:      $kit_nav_ok, $kit_lat, $kit_lon (degrees), $kit_hdg (degrees),
;              $kit_tdist (m, -1 = no target) and $kit_tbrg (degrees true).
;    contacts: $kit_cn contacts; arrays $kit_c_name, $kit_c_fix (1 when it
;              sends its own lat/lon), $kit_c_lat, $kit_c_lon, $kit_c_brg
;              (degrees true from here, -1 unknown), $kit_c_dist (m, -1),
;              $kit_c_age (s since heard, -1 never).
;  ---- v4: map canvas ----
;  @kit_canvas() (before @kit_app) lets the app draw a 860 x 860 picture
;  layer that ChipOS keeps and shows, turned, in the app and its widgets:
;    @kit_layer_begin("#bg", "#c0,#c1,...")   new layer, palette up to 16
;    @kit_layer_op(text)                      encoded drawing (see below)
;    @kit_layer_end()
;  It is sent in parts while ChipOS draws it; $kit_lid_front is the layer
;  ChipOS shows (complete), @kit_layer_busy() while one is being sent.
;  Encoding (@kit_venc numbers): polyline 0,colour,n,x,y,dx,dy...;
;  filled spans 1,colour,top,height,n,(gap,length)...
;  In a frame: @kit_view(x, y, w, h, cx, cy, turn, flip) shows the layer
;  (cx, cy = layer pixel in the middle; turn = degrees clockwise). Then, in
;  layer pixels: @kit_vline, @kit_vdot, @kit_vring, @kit_vlabel, @kit_vcity, @kit_varrow,
;  @kit_vpoly, and @kit_vcompass(), @kit_vnorth(), @kit_vscale(km per px),
;  @kit_vmsg(colour, text) on top, @kit_vnote(colour, text) bottom left.
; =====================================================================
const $kit_host = "chipos"
var $kit_name = ""
var $kit_manifest = ""
var $kit_open = 0
var $kit_tap = ""
var $kit_clock = ""
var $kit_day = 0
var $kit_units = 0
var $kit_mins = 0                       ; ChipOS clock, minutes since day 1 00:00
var $kit_mins_t = 0                     ; this computer's time when it arrived
var $kit_seq = -1
var $kit_rx = ""
var $kit_frame = ""
var $kit_sent = ""
var $kit_dirty = 1
var $kit_redraw_next = 0
var $kit_input_id = ""
var $kit_input_text = ""
var $kit_input_cancel = 0
var $kit_clear = 0                      ; 1 for one tick: ChipOS asked to wipe this app's data
var $kit_off = 0                        ; uninstalled: silent until this program restarts
var $kit_rq = 0
var $kit_bq = 0
var $kit_color = ""
var $kit_glyph = ""
var $kit_icon_s = ""
var $kit_want_s = ""
var $kit_cv = 0
var $kit_rx1 = ""
var $kit_rx2 = ""
var $kit_feed_seen = ""
var $kit_feed_new = 0
var $kit_nav_ok = 0
var $kit_lat = 0
var $kit_lon = 0
var $kit_hdg = 0
var $kit_tdist = -1
var $kit_tbrg = -1
var $kit_cn = 0
array $kit_c_name : text
array $kit_c_fix : number
array $kit_c_lat : number
array $kit_c_lon : number
array $kit_c_brg : number
array $kit_c_dist : number
array $kit_c_age : number
array $kit_fp : text
const $kit_alpha = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_-"
var $kit_lid = 0
var $kit_lid_send = -1
var $kit_lid_front = -1
array $kit_lq : text
var $kit_lq_end = 0
var $kit_lp = 0
var $kit_lhead = ""
var $kit_lbuf = ""
var $kit_lt = 0
var $kit_wdefs = ""
var $kit_hb = 0
var $kit_hb_next = 0
var $kit_wnext = 0
var $kit_wdirty = 1
array $kit_wsent : text

function @kit_mk()
	$kit_manifest = ".kit{4}.name{" & $kit_name & "}.color{" & $kit_color & "}.glyph{" & $kit_glyph & "}.hb{" & text("{}", $kit_hb) & "}"
	if $kit_wdefs != ""
		$kit_manifest = $kit_manifest & ".widgets{" & $kit_wdefs & "}"
	if $kit_icon_s != ""
		$kit_manifest = $kit_manifest & ".icon{" & $kit_icon_s & "}"
	if $kit_want_s != ""
		$kit_manifest = $kit_manifest & ".want{" & $kit_want_s & "}"
	if $kit_cv
		$kit_manifest = $kit_manifest & ".canvas{1}"

; Ask ChipOS for data (call before @kit_app): "nav", "contacts" or both.
function @kit_want($list : text)
	$kit_want_s = $list

; This app draws a map canvas (call before @kit_app).
function @kit_canvas()
	$kit_cv = 1
	$kit_lid = random(1, 900000)

; Your own icon (call before @kit_app). See the shapes above.
function @kit_icon($spec : text)
	$kit_icon_s = $spec

; Declare a home-screen widget (call before @kit_app).
function @kit_widget($name : text, $w : number, $h : number)
	if $kit_wdefs != ""
		$kit_wdefs = $kit_wdefs & "|"
	$kit_wdefs = $kit_wdefs & $name & text("~{}~{}", $w, $h)
	$kit_wsent.append("")

function @kit_app($name : text, $color : text, $glyph : text)
	$kit_name = $name
	$kit_color = $color
	$kit_glyph = $glyph
	@kit_mk()
	output_text($kit_host, 0, $kit_manifest)
	output_text($kit_host, 1, "")
	output_text($kit_host, 2, "")
	output_text($kit_host, 3, "")

; ---- v4: feeds ----
function @kit_feed()
	var $f = $kit_feed_seen
	$kit_feed_new = 1
	$kit_nav_ok = $f.nok == "1"
	if $kit_nav_ok
		$kit_lat = $f.lat:number
		$kit_lon = $f.lon:number
		$kit_hdg = $f.hd:number
	$kit_tdist = -1
	$kit_tbrg = -1
	if $f.tdist != ""
		$kit_tdist = $f.tdist:number
		$kit_tbrg = $f.tbrg:number
	$kit_c_name.clear()
	$kit_c_fix.clear()
	$kit_c_lat.clear()
	$kit_c_lon.clear()
	$kit_c_brg.clear()
	$kit_c_dist.clear()
	$kit_c_age.clear()
	$kit_cn = 0
	if $f.cn != ""
		$kit_cn = $f.cn:number
	repeat $kit_cn ($i)
		var $key = "c" & text("{}", $i)
		var $p = 0
		var $rest = $f.$key
		$kit_fp.clear()
		repeat 6 ($q)
			$p = find($rest, "~")
			if $p < 0
				$kit_fp.append($rest)
				$rest = ""
			else
				$kit_fp.append(substring($rest, 0, $p))
				$rest = substring($rest, $p + 1, size($rest))
		$kit_c_name.append($kit_fp.0)
		var $la = 0
		var $lo = 0
		var $fx = 0
		if isnumeric($kit_fp.1) and isnumeric($kit_fp.2)
			$la = $kit_fp.1:number
			$lo = $kit_fp.2:number
			$fx = 1
		$kit_c_fix.append($fx)
		$kit_c_lat.append($la)
		$kit_c_lon.append($lo)
		var $b = -1
		if isnumeric($kit_fp.3)
			$b = $kit_fp.3:number
		$kit_c_brg.append($b)
		var $d = -1
		if isnumeric($kit_fp.4)
			$d = $kit_fp.4:number
		$kit_c_dist.append($d)
		var $ag = -1
		if isnumeric($kit_fp.5)
			$ag = $kit_fp.5:number
		$kit_c_age.append($ag)

; ---- v4: the canvas layer ----
function @kit_venc($v : number) : text
	var $z = $v * 2
	if $v < 0
		$z = -$v * 2 - 1
	$z = floor($z)
	if $z < 32
		return substring($kit_alpha, $z, 1)
	var $o = ""
	repeat 8 ($q)
		if $z < 32
			return $o & substring($kit_alpha, $z, 1)
		$o = $o & substring($kit_alpha, 32 + mod($z, 32), 1)
		$z = floor($z / 32)
	return $o

function @kit_layer_begin($bg : text, $pal : text) : number
	$kit_lid += 1
	$kit_lid_send = $kit_lid
	$kit_lq.clear()
	$kit_lq_end = 0
	$kit_lp = 0
	$kit_lbuf = ""
	$kit_lhead = ".bg{" & $bg & "}.pal{" & $pal & "}"
	return $kit_lid

function @kit_layer_op($op : text)
	if size($kit_lbuf) + size($op) > 3300
		$kit_lq.append($kit_lbuf)
		$kit_lbuf = ""
	$kit_lbuf = $kit_lbuf & $op

function @kit_layer_end()
	$kit_lq.append($kit_lbuf)
	$kit_lbuf = ""
	$kit_lq_end = 1

function @kit_layer_busy() : number
	return $kit_lid_send >= 0

; Send the next part when ChipOS asks for it.
function @kit_layer_pump()
	var $a = $kit_rx2
	var $al = -2
	var $aw = -1
	var $ad = -2
	if $a != ""
		$al = $a.lid:number
		$aw = $a.want:number
		$ad = $a.done:number
	if $kit_lid_send < 0
		; ChipOS lost the layer it showed (restarted): send it again
		if ($a != "") and ($kit_lid_front >= 0) and ($ad != $kit_lid_front) and ($al != $kit_lid_front) and ($kit_lq.size > 0) and (time > $kit_lt + 3)
			$kit_lid_send = $kit_lid_front
			$kit_lp = 0
		else
			return
	if $ad == $kit_lid_send
		$kit_lid_front = $kit_lid_send
		$kit_lid_send = -1
		$kit_dirty = 1
		$kit_wdirty = 1
		return
	var $p = $kit_lp
	if ($p < $kit_lq.size) and (($p == 0) or (($al == $kit_lid_send) and ($aw == $p)))
		var $e = 0
		if $kit_lq_end and ($p == $kit_lq.size - 1)
			$e = 1
		var $m = ".lid{" & text("{}", $kit_lid_send) & "}.p{" & text("{}", $p) & "}.end{" & text("{}", $e) & "}"
		if $p == 0
			$m = $m & $kit_lhead
		output_text($kit_host, 8, $m & ".d{" & $kit_lq.$p & "}")
		$kit_lp = $p + 1
		$kit_lt = time
	elseif time > $kit_lt + 4
		; no answer: start the layer over
		$kit_lp = 0
		$kit_lt = time

; Call first thing in update. Sets $kit_tap for one tick when a button is tapped.
function @kit_poll()
	$kit_tap = ""
	$kit_clear = 0
	$kit_input_id = ""
	$kit_input_text = ""
	$kit_input_cancel = 0
	if $kit_off
		return
	; Heartbeat: re-publish the manifest every 2 s, so ChipOS knows we run.
	if time >= $kit_hb_next
		$kit_hb_next = time + 2
		$kit_hb += 1
		@kit_mk()
		output_text($kit_host, 0, $kit_manifest)
	if time >= $kit_redraw_next
		$kit_redraw_next = time + 5
		$kit_dirty = 1
	$kit_feed_new = 0
	if $kit_rx1 != $kit_feed_seen
		$kit_feed_seen = $kit_rx1
		@kit_feed()
	if $kit_cv
		@kit_layer_pump()
	var $ev = $kit_rx
	if $ev == ""
		return
	var $sq = $ev.seq:number
	if $sq == $kit_seq
		return
	$kit_seq = $sq
	$kit_clock = $ev.clock
	$kit_day = $ev.day:number
	$kit_units = $ev.units:number
	$kit_mins = $ev.mins:number
	$kit_mins_t = time
	var $e = $ev.ev
	if $e == "open"
		$kit_open = 1
		$kit_dirty = 1
		$kit_tap = $ev.id
	elseif $e == "close"
		$kit_open = 0
	elseif $e == "tap"
		$kit_open = 1
		$kit_tap = $ev.id
		$kit_dirty = 1
	elseif $e == "uninstall"
		; unload: blank every output; ChipOS ignores us until we restart
		$kit_off = 1
		$kit_open = 0
		repeat 8 ($oc)
			output_text($kit_host, $oc, "")
	elseif $e == "clear"
		$kit_clear = 1
		$kit_dirty = 1
		$kit_wdirty = 1
	elseif $e == "wtap"
		$kit_tap = $ev.id
		$kit_wdirty = 1
		$kit_dirty = 1
	elseif $e == "tick"
		$kit_open = 1
		$kit_dirty = 1
	elseif $e == "input"
		$kit_input_id = $ev.id
		$kit_input_text = $ev.text
		$kit_dirty = 1
	elseif $e == "input_cancel"
		$kit_input_id = $ev.id
		$kit_input_cancel = 1
		$kit_dirty = 1

function @kit_invalidate()
	$kit_dirty = 1

; Ask ChipOS for text from the keyboard.
function @kit_input($id : text, $prompt : text, $init : text)
	if $kit_off
		return
	$kit_rq += 1
	var $rq_t = text("{}", $kit_rq)
	output_text($kit_host, 2, ".rq{" & $rq_t & "}.id{" & $id & "}.prompt{" & $prompt & "}.init{" & $init & "}")

; Beep on ChipOS's buzzers.
function @kit_beep($f : number, $d : number)
	if $kit_off
		return
	$kit_bq += 1
	var $bq_t = text("{}", $kit_bq)
	var $bf_t = text("{}", $f)
	var $bd_t = text("{}", $d)
	output_text($kit_host, 3, ".rq{" & $bq_t & "}.f{" & $bf_t & "}.d{" & $bd_t & "}")

; Redraw while open, at most once a second unless something happened.
function @kit_should_draw() : number
	return $kit_open and $kit_dirty and (!$kit_off)

function @kit_begin()
	$kit_frame = ""

function @kit_add($el : text)
	; a screen is one text of at most 4096 characters: leave out what does not fit
	if size($kit_frame) + size($el) > 4000
		return
	if $kit_frame != ""
		$kit_frame = $kit_frame & "|"
	$kit_frame = $kit_frame & $el

function @kit_end()
	$kit_dirty = 0
	if $kit_off
		return
	if $kit_frame != $kit_sent
		$kit_sent = $kit_frame
		output_text($kit_host, 1, $kit_frame)

; Widgets: time to redraw? (about once a second, or right after a tap)
function @kit_widget_due() : number
	if $kit_off
		return 0
	if $kit_wdirty or (time >= $kit_wnext)
		$kit_wdirty = 0
		$kit_wnext = time + 1
		return 1
	return 0

function @kit_wend($n : number)
	if $kit_off
		return
	if ($n >= 0) and ($n < $kit_wsent.size)
		if $kit_frame != $kit_wsent.$n
			$kit_wsent.$n = $kit_frame
			output_text($kit_host, 4 + $n, $kit_frame)
